name: order_liver_function_panel
description: Orders Liver Function Tests (LFTs) including ALT, AST, ALP, total bilirubin, direct bilirubin, albumin, and total protein. Used to evaluate hepatic function, detect liver injury, and monitor liver disease progression.
when_to_use: Abdominal pain with suspected hepatobiliary involvement

examples.query: Check liver function for this patient
Order LFTs stat, patient is jaundiced
